sn56.48:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ayam mahāpathavī ekodakā assa ||
sn56.48:1.3: tam enam puratthimo vāto pacchimena saṃhareyya || pacchimo vāto puratthimena saṃhareyya || uttaro vāto dakkhiṇena saṃhareyya || dakkhiṇo vāto uttarena saṃhareyya || ||
sn56.48:1.4: Tatrassa kāṇo kacchapo so vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjeyya || || 3.
sn56.48:1.6: api nu so kāṇo kacchapo vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakim ummujjanto amusmim ekacchiggaḷe yuge gīvam paveseyyā ti || ||
sn56.48:1.7: Adhiccam idam bhante yaṃ so kāṇo kacchapo vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakim ummujjanto amusmim ekacchiggaḷe yuge gīvam paveseyyā ti || || 4.
sn56.48:2.1: Evam adhiccam idam bhikkhave yam manussattam labhati ||
sn56.48:2.2: evam adhiccam idam bhikkhave yaṃ Tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho ||
sn56.48:2.3: evam adhiccam idam bhikkhave yaṃ tathāgatapavedito dhammavinayo loke dippati || || 5.
sn56.48:2.4: Tassidam bhikkhave manussattam laddhaṃ || tathāgato ca loke uppanno arahaṃ sammāsambuddho || tathāgatappavedito ca dhammavinayo loke dippati || || 6.
sn56.48:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idam dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayam dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo
